40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Add 4 days → total 284 days.  
Start: 1064-09-19.  
Add 284 days: 1064 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
Days from Sep 19 to Dec 31: 12 (Sep) + 31 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 104 days from Sep 19 to end of year.  
284 − 104 = 180 days remain into 1065.  
1065 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4). Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 181 days from Jan 1 to Jun 30.  
180 days into 1065 = up to Jun 29 (since Jan 1 is day 1, 180 days later is Jan 1 + 179 days = Jun 29).  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1065-06-29
